items.q: he was staying uptown, sleeping up to Monroe's place uptown, Monroe's uptown house, that's where we used to go all the time.

ctx.x: So it was kind of a surprise when --

Yeah, it really was kind of a surprise. I tried to get him in Basie's band, though. When we come to New York in '39, he really hadn't made it, you know. And he was staying uptown, sleeping up to Monroe's place uptown, Monroe's uptown house, that's where we used to go all the time. And he was like sleeping in the basement up there. And he always wanted to be with the band because he felt like being from Kansas City, he should have been, you know. And of course, at the time, we didn't have but four saxaphone and…
